title: Claude Code: Use Claude Code in the cloud
summary: A cloud session runs Claude Code on Anthropic's infrastructure, keeps running when the laptop closes and is steered from the browser, the phone, the Desktop app or the terminal. claude --cloud starts one per task; claude -p "msg" --cloud <session-id> queues a follow-up into an existing one from any machine; --teleport pulls one into the terminal. The session rail beside the chat shows Environment, Changes (with PR and CI), what is running and Context. Commands that open a terminal picker or panel behave differently, and /plugin is not available. Sessions stop after inactivity and are restored on reopen without their background work.
ideas: Starting a thread per intent and messaging it are both one CLI command today.
A cloud session's transcript is read at claude.ai/code; it cannot answer a cross-machine message with SendMessage.
Nothing a mod draws shows in a cloud session.

took.idea: One cloud session per intent, linked from its record
